items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: somebody sent me footage of my mother recently, playing with Max Roach or something like that. And I didn’t know she played with Max Roach.

ctx.x: I think it was just, “Dad, what are you doing?” So I wondered if it was the same for you.

Well kids I guess don’t think their folks are human beings. Don’t think we were ever young or something. So it’s weird to them. They don’t want to think that about us. But I actually, you know, I am still excited — like when I see — somebody sent me footage of my mother recently, playing with Max Roach or something like that. And I didn’t know she played with Max Roach. You know, so it was like of course she played with — she played with everybody. So I really liked seeing them as people.
Did she talk about travails of being on the road?
